name: All Objects
query:
SELECT 
    work_team,
    team_name,
    team_leader,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Completed Projects`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Pending Projects`
FROM 
    `tabProject Setup`
GROUP BY 
    work_team, team_leader;
